newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FOCUS - DSM Q1 net up nine pct, upbeat on H1.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - DSM Q1 net up nine pct, upbeat on H1.

text.p: Dutch petrochemicals group DSM NV said on Tuesday net profit for the first quarter of 1997 rose some nine percent to 223 million guilders from 205 million in the same period of 1996.

DSM also said it expected its results for the first half of 1997 to be better than those for the same period of 1996, raising a previous forecast that its first-half results would broadly match those of the year-earlier period.

DSM said the improvement was due to good demand and an expansion of its activities, quoting chairman Simon de Bree as saying profit margins had on average almost recovered to the levels of the first quarter of 1996.
"The upward trend in the selling prices of a number of important DSM products which had started in the second half of 1996 continued in the first quarter of 1997," it said.

DSM said it did not foresee any big changes in current favourable market conditions during the coming months and that it therefore expected first-half 1997 earnings to be higher than those for the first half of 1996. But it added that it was too early yet to make a forecast for the whole of this year.
DSM's net profit for the first quarter was slightly higher than analysts' consensus forecast of 217 million guilders.
